item.title: JOBURGS PRIDE SMASHES PINK DAY OUT THE PARK
item.description: The sold-out DP World Wanderers Stadium PitchedUpInPink for the 3rd T20 International on Saturday; celebrating life, creating awareness and pledging towards a genuinely fantastic cause. The post JOBURGS PRIDE SMASHES PINK DAY OUT THE PARK first appeared on Cricket South Africa.

item.title: Girls in Blue set to restart Hollywoodbets Pro Series campaign with confidence this weekend
item.description: World Sports Betting Western Province Women head coach Claire Terblanche says there is a real sense of excitement within the camp as the team prepares to return to action against Six Gun Grill Garden Route Badgers Women in round six of the Hollywoodbets Pro Series. The post Girls in Blue set to restart Hollywoodbets Pro Series campaign with confidence this weekend first appeared on Cricket South Africa.

item.title: KNIGHTS AND STORM BATTLE IT OUT FOR 4 DAY SUPREMACY
item.description: The 2025/26 Division 2 4 Day Series reaches its climax with Eastern Storm and the Flexbrands Knights preparing to contest a highly anticipated final, with silverware ambitions on the line at the Mangaung Oval starting on Friday. item.title: HOLLYWOODBETS PRO SERIES RETURNS WITH ALL EYES ON WOMEN’S CRICKET THIS MONTH
item.description: February will shine the light on South African women’s cricket as the Hollywoodbets Pro Series resumes this weekend with fixtures across the country. The post HOLLYWOODBETS PRO SERIES RETURNS WITH ALL EYES ON WOMEN’S CRICKET THIS MONTH first appeared on Cricket South Africa.

item.title: KAYLA REYNEKE: A MASSIVE PRIVILEGE TO WEAR THE PROTEAS WOMEN’S BADGE
item.description: Former South Africa Under-19 Women’s captain and all-rounder Kayla Reyneke has expressed her excitement ahead of the Proteas Women’s upcoming three-match T20 International (T20I) series from 10–16 February, following her first-ever national call-up. The post KAYLA REYNEKE: A MASSIVE PRIVILEGE TO WEAR THE PROTEAS WOMEN’S BADGE first appeared on Cricket South Africa.

item.title: BIG STATEMENTS FROM WP AND TITANS LADIES AS HOLLYWOODBETS PRO SERIES RESUMES

item.title: WINNING WAYS CONTINUE FOR WESTERN PROVINCE AND TITANS LADIES
item.description: WSB Western Province Women continued their fine form in the Hollywoodbets Pro20 with a thrilling two-wicket victory against Garden Route Badgers Women on Sunday. The post WINNING WAYS CONTINUE FOR WESTERN PROVINCE AND TITANS LADIES first appeared on Cricket South Africa.

item.title: KNIGHTS CROWNED DIVISION 2 4 DAY SERIES CHAMPIONS AFTER DRAWN FINAL AGAINST STORM
item.description: Flexbrands Knights secured the Division 2 4 Day Series title after their final against Eastern Storm ended in a draw at the Mangaung Oval, as Gihahn Cloete's double century led the way. The post KNIGHTS CROWNED DIVISION 2 4 DAY SERIES CHAMPIONS AFTER DRAWN FINAL AGAINST STORM first appeared on Cricket South Africa.

item.title: REYNEKE STEALS THE SHOW ON DEBUT AS PROTEAS WOMEN DEFEAT A PLUCKY PAKISTAN IN FIRST T20I
item.description: Kayla Reyneke enjoyed a dream debut with bat and ball as the Proteas Women secured a five-wicket victory over Pakistan in the first T20 International (T20I) in Potchefstroom on Tuesday. The win handed the hosts a 1–0 series lead with two matches remaining. The post REYNEKE STEALS THE SHOW ON DEBUT AS PROTEAS WOMEN DEFEAT A PLUCKY PAKISTAN IN FIRST T20I first appeared on Cricket South Africa.

item.title: 10 YEARS ON: WOLVAARDT RETURNS TO WHERE IT ALL BEGAN FOR SECOND T20I AGAINST PAKISTAN
item.description: Proteas Women captain Laura Wolvaardt marks her 10-year anniversary as an international cricketer this month, returning to the venue where she made her debut as the Proteas Women prepare to face Pakistan in the second T20 International (T20I) in Benoni on Friday. The post 10 YEARS ON: WOLVAARDT RETURNS TO WHERE IT ALL BEGAN FOR SECOND T20I AGAINST PAKISTAN first appeared on Cricket South Africa.
